subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The incorrectly spelt word is: **Judege**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The correct spelling should be "**Judge**"
 
• **Judge**: A person in a court who has the authority to decide how criminals should be punished or to make legal decisions. (न्यायाधीश) 
 
 
• For example- *He is due to appear before a judge and jury on Monday*.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 2, which is incorrectly spelt.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Justice**: The condition of being morally correct or fair. (न्याय)
 
• **Attorney**: A person, typically a lawyer, appointed to act for another in business or legal matters. (न्यायवादी)
 
• **Lawyer**: Someone whose job is to give advice to people about the law and speak for them in court. (वकील)
